bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || test -f "$root/.git" || exit 60
printf 'GATEAPP_HEAD='; git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'GATEAPP_BRANCH='; git -C "$root" branch --show-current
printf 'GATEAPP_STATUS='; git -C "$root" status --porcelain | wc -l
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_ENABLED='; systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'GAYBBS_CONTAINER_COUNT='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true
printf 'REPORT_PR_HEAD='; git -C "$root" ls-remote origin refs/heads/chat/bug-report-userbot-20261115 | cut -f1
